# FloatText { #anylumino.FloatText }

```python
FloatText(
    value=0.0,
    description='',
    disabled=False,
    continuous_update=True,
    layout=None,
    style=None,
)
```

Float text input control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name              | Type     | Description                                                           | Default    |
|-------------------|----------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| value | optional | Initial value and synced Python value. | `0.0` |
| description | optional | Label shown next to the control. | `''` |
| disabled | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled. | `False` |
| continuous_update | optional | Whether Python receives updates while the user is typing or dragging. | `True` |
| layout | optional | ipywidgets ``Layout`` object for CSS sizing and spacing. | `None` |
| style | optional | ipywidgets style object or style dictionary. | `None` |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [continuous_update](#anylumino.FloatText.continuous_update) | Update the value as the user types. If False, update on submission, e.g., pressing Enter or navigating away. |
| [disabled](#anylumino.FloatText.disabled) | Enable or disable user changes |
| [step](#anylumino.FloatText.step) | Minimum step to increment the value |
